title: Execute guard-to-diagnostic-to-compensation failure-path integration tests
scope: SD.md D3 only. Executable failure-path integration tests covering guard-to-diagnostic-to-compensation with real subprocesses and isolated lease/bootstrap/SSH/HTTP fixtures. D1-D2 were delivered in DEV502-CAPTURE-001. D4-D6 (hosted TRACE/RCA, product FIX, durable diagnostics) and step 5 belong to follow-on tasks. Local fixtures are not hosted runtime proof.

d3_1_baseline_success.requirement: Baseline success does not execute failure collector
verifications: Real guard executable scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh exits 0
Guard failure file is not created
SSH execution log confirms baseline ran and collector was never invoked
collection-status.json records collectionStatus='not_required', bootstrapExit=0, collectorExit=0
diagnostics.json is not created
Heartbeat process remains healthy throughout

d3_2_baseline_exit1_capture_before_heart.requirement: Baseline exit 1: capture precedes heartbeat stop; outer guard exits 75 and records original exit 1
verifications: Timing probe during collector execution proves heartbeat process is ALIVE
Timing probe during collector execution proves guard failure file does NOT exist yet
Outer guard terminates with exit 75
Guard failure file records original baseline exitStatus=1
Diagnostics directory contains valid diagnostics.json, matching SHA256SUMS, and collectionStatus='ok'
Guard cleanup stops heartbeat for quarantine

d3_3_collector_failure_paths.requirement: Collector timeout, command exit, and corrupted JSON: bootstrap failure exit preserved, rollback reachable
verifications: Collector timeout (deadline exceeded) preserves original bootstrap exit 1, records collectionStatus='timeout', and quarantines lease
Collector error exit (e.g. exit 2, ssh connection refused) preserves bootstrap exit 1 and records collectorErrorCategory='ssh_connection_refused'
Corrupted JSON output preserves bootstrap exit 1, records collectionStatus='invalid_json', and cleans up broken artifact files

d3_4_heartbeat_and_cas_loss.requirement: Heartbeat or remote CAS loss: command process group terminated, no further remote command runs
verifications: Mid-command heartbeat loss triggers guard fail_guarded_command; terminates COMMAND_PGID; guard exits 75; collector never runs
Remote CAS verification failure triggers guard fail_guarded_command; terminates COMMAND_PGID; guard exits 75

d3_5_cancellation_and_identity_mismatch_.requirement: Cancellation, missing/expired state, wrong source, ambiguous containers fail closed
verifications: Baseline cancellation (SIGTERM exit 143) terminates wrapper immediately without running collector; status remains 'not_started'
Missing lease token, missing state file, or missing wrapper env variables fail closed with exit 75 before command execution
Candidate source SHA mismatch sets identity_matches=false, collectionStatus='identity_mismatch', and fails acceptance

d3_6_artifact_output_verification.requirement: Artifact output missing, upload failure, or bad checksum cannot declare diagnostic acceptance
verifications: Missing collection-status.json fails acceptance
Non-ok collectionStatus (e.g. timeout) fails acceptance
Missing diagnostics.json fails acceptance
Missing SHA256SUMS fails acceptance
Corrupted or mismatched checksum in SHA256SUMS fails acceptance
Valid files and correct checksum pass acceptance

d3_7_project_exceptions_and_secret_senti.requirement: Project domain exceptions and Persona owner positively captured; secret sentinels never leak
verifications: Positive capture of services.control_plane.bff.ports.persona_write_owner.PersonaWriteOwnerUnavailable
Positive capture of services.control_plane.bff.persona_provisioning.ProvisioningLeaseLost
Positive capture of standard exceptions (e.g. ConnectionRefusedError)
Zero leakage of sensitive sentinels (tokens, passwords, DSNs, JWTs) into parsed events or envelope

d3_8_compensation_independent_outcomes.requirement: Normal compensation and failed compensation retain true independent outcomes
verifications: Successful compensation runs real scripts/compensate_cross_repo_release.sh under pinned lease controller commit 9e564718da8c39199a4c311f1a667b74226e3428, restores pair, verifies endpoints, produces release-compensation.json with outcome='compensated', stops heartbeat safely, and releases lease (exit 0)
Failed compensation (e.g. deploy failure or endpoint mismatch) exits 75 without creating release-compensation.json, leaving lease quarantined
